## Method

- Commits: `git log HEAD` (or `--all`), author date in the author's own time zone.
- Subject lines are lower-cased and Turkish diacritics are folded to ASCII before matching.
- Category patterns (regular expressions):
  - `fix`: `\b(fix(es|ed)?|bugfix|hotfix|bug|duzelt\w*|hata\w*)\b`
  - `feat`: `\b(feat|feature|add(ed|s)?|implement\w*|introduce\w*|ekle\w*|yeni|ilk surum)\b`
  - `test`: `\b(test\w*)\b`
  - `revert`: `\b(revert\w*|geri al\w*)\b`
- Test file convention: names such as `test_*.py`, `*_test.go`, `*.test.ts`, `*.spec.*`, or source files inside a `tests/`, `test/`, `__tests__/` or `spec/` directory.
- Test command results come from the tool's own summary line; if the format is not recognised only the exit code is shown.
